    About this home

    Welcome to your dream golf course home in Trilogy at Power Ranch, Gilbert's premier 55+ resort-style community. This beautifully maintained retreat sits on a premium golf course lot and features bright, open living spaces with stunning views from the living room and kitchen. Enjoy your morning coffee on the covered patio and unwind in the evenings around the custom Sonoran stone seating area and fire pit while taking in Arizona's breathtaking sunrises and sunsets. The home includes granite kitchen countertops, newer AC unit for energy-efficient comfort, and an extended garage with plenty of space for your golf cart or extra storage. Whether you're a golf enthusiast or simply seeking the ultimate active adult lifestyle, this home delivers. Living in Trilogy means access to... ...exceptional amenities including a championship golf course, resort-style pool, clubhouse, fitness center, tennis and pickleball courts, scenic walking paths, and a full calendar of social clubs and events - all within one of Gilbert's most desirable and welcoming communities.
